description: This file defines internal implementation details for boxing and unboxing kernel functions in PyTorch, including argument validation, conversion between IValues and C++ types, and wrapping kernel functors for dispatching.

classes.name: assert_is_valid_input_type
classes.description: Template struct for validating input argument types for kernel functions.

classes.name: assert_is_valid_output_type
classes.description: Template struct for validating output argument types for kernel functions.

classes.name: ivalue_to_arg
classes.description: Template struct for converting IValues to C++ argument types.

classes.name: return_to_ivalue
classes.description: Template struct for converting C++ return values to IValues.

classes.name: wrap_kernel_functor_unboxed_
classes.description: Template struct for wrapping unboxed kernel functors for dispatch.

classes.name: make_boxed_from_unboxed_functor
classes.description: Template struct for creating boxed kernel functors from unboxed ones.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Invokes a kernel functor with arguments extracted from the stack, handling argument conversion and dispatch key plumbing.

methods.name: call_functor_with_args_from_stack
methods.description: Calls a kernel functor with arguments from the stack, excluding the dispatch key.

methods.name: push_outputs
methods.description: Pushes kernel outputs onto the stack, handling different output types including tuples and void.
